description: A client player whose respawn point is a charged respawn anchor in the Nether dies in the overworld and respawns at the anchor (PlayerList.respawn): the anchor loses a charge and plays block.respawn_anchor.deplete to the player, seeded from the Nether's level random. All Nether chunks in the player's simulation distance are forced.

actions.command: execute in minecraft:the_nether run setblock 4 4 4 minecraft:respawn_anchor[charges=2]
execute in minecraft:the_nether run spawnpoint steve 4 4 4
